card.title: PlayStation 4 BGA Reflow and Removal Thermal Profile Settings

claims.statement: Profile 1 is used to remove or reflow BGA with leaded or unleaded solder, focusing on temperature measurements and time rather than a specific reflow pattern.
claims.evidence: Profile settings and parameters specified in the source text for BGA work.
claims.quote: Profile 1is used to remove or reflow BGA with leaded / unleaded solder. There is no specific reflow pattern for XBOX, PS5, Switch it’s al about temperature measurements and time!

claims.statement: The thermal profile uses specific stages including preheat, soak, reflow, and cool.
claims.evidence: Ramp rates (R), temperature levels (L), and dwell/duration times (D) are provided for 6 zones.
